title: Running Commentary on Torah 45 — Mach'as Kapayim b'Tefilah
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 45 — מחאת כפיים בתפילה
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Direct line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text.

beginner.en: **"Mahus **mach'as kapayim bi'tefilah**: through it, **kenafayim are awakened** — source of dibbur: **'u'va'al kenafayim yagid davar'** (Kohelet 10:20); **'vi'dei adam mi'tachas kenafayhem'** (Yechezkel 10:21). Thus when one awakens his yadayim, **kenapim awaken** — the **kenafei ri'ah** (wings of the lung) whence dibbur forms."** **"But still must **prepare+rectify the peh** to receive the dibbur. Via striking **kaf el kaf** — the **peh is formed**. For each hand has **5 etzba'os**; striking **yad-yamin against yad-s'mol** = **5 hakha'os against 5** = **5×5=25 (koh, כ"ה) ohros**. **Peh=5 motza'os**: velar (gimel yud chaf kuf), palatal (dalet tes lamed nun tav), labial (beis vav mem peh), dental (zayin samech shin resh tzadi), glottal (alef hei ches ayin); each motza'a draws from the hakha'as kaf."**

intermediate.en: **Mach'as kapayim**=awakens **kenapim** (Koh 10:20; Yech 10:21) — source of dibbur. Also **prepares peh**: 5 etzba'os × 5 = **5 motza'os ha'peh** (guttural/palatal/lingual/dental/labial).
intermediate.he: **מחאת כפיים**=מעוררת **כנפיים** (קה' י, כ; יחז' י, כא) — מקור הדיבור. גם **מכינה פה**: ה' אצבעות × ה' = **ה' מוצאות הפה** (גיכ"ק, דטלנ"ת, בומ"פ, זסשר"ץ, אחה"ע).

scholarly.he: קה' י, כ; יחז' י, כא; ה' מוצאות.
